question: How many films are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film

question: Kaç müşteri var?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer

question: How many customers are active?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer WHERE active = 1

question: What is the length of the longest film, in minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT max(length) FROM film

question: What are the distinct rental rates, from highest to lowest?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT rental_rate FROM film ORDER BY rental_rate DESC

question: How many films are rated PG-13?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG-13'

question: What is the average film length?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(length) FROM film

question: Toplam ödeme tutarı nedir?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM payment

question: How many actors are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM actor

question: Which category has the most films?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many films does each category have? Give category name and count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, count(*) AS n FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id

question: Which actor has appeared in the most films? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many films has the actor PENELOPE GUINESS appeared in?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film_actor fa JOIN actor a ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'PENELOPE' AND a.last_name = 'GUINESS'

question: List the titles of films in the Horror category.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror'

question: Which customer has spent the most money in total? Give first name, last name and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, sum(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total revenue of each store? Give store id and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT s.store_id, sum(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payment p JOIN staff s ON s.staff_id = p.staff_id GROUP BY s.store_id

question: How many rentals were made in May 2005?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental WHERE rental_date >= '2005-05-01' AND rental_date < '2005-06-01'

question: How many rentals have not been returned yet?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL

question: How many customers live in Turkey?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Turkey'

question: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT co.country FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the distinct film ratings.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT rating FROM film

question: How many films are longer than two hours?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE length > 120

question: What is the most common rental duration in days?
gold_sql: SELECT rental_duration FROM film GROUP BY rental_duration ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many copies of the film ACADEMY DINOSAUR are in inventory?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'

question: Which film has been rented the most times?
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: En çok kiralanan 2 film hangileri? Başlık ve kiralama sayısını ver.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, count(*) AS n FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 2

question: How much revenue did the film BUCKET BROTHERHOOD generate?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE f.title = 'BUCKET BROTHERHOOD'

question: How many staff members are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM staff

question: Which language are the films in? List distinct language names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.name FROM film f JOIN language l ON l.language_id = f.language_id

question: How many films have 'Deleted Scenes' among their special features?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE special_features LIKE '%Deleted Scenes%'

question: What is the average payment amount?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(amount) FROM payment

question: How many payments were larger than 5 dollars?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM payment WHERE amount > 5

question: How many customers live in the city of London?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id WHERE ci.city = 'London'

question: List the first and last names of customers whose last name is SMITH.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE last_name = 'SMITH'

question: How many films were released in 2006?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE release_year = 2006

question: What is the total number of rentals per month in 2005? Give month (YYYY-MM) and count.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', rental_date) AS month, count(*) AS n FROM rental WHERE rental_date >= '2005-01-01' AND rental_date < '2006-01-01' GROUP BY month

question: How many films does the actor with actor_id 1 have in the Documentary category?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film_actor fa JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE fa.actor_id = 1 AND c.name = 'Documentary'

question: Which films cost more than 25 dollars to replace and are rated R? List the titles.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 25 AND rating = 'R'

question: What is the email address of the customer MARY SMITH?
gold_sql: SELECT email FROM customer WHERE first_name = 'MARY' AND last_name = 'SMITH'

question: How many distinct customers have rented a film in the Sci-Fi category?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT r.customer_id) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Sci-Fi'
